steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX functionality required for the event flow.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFP.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available questionnaire template.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Complete the mandatory questionnaire content for the RFP.
Assign the evaluator required for publishing a technical event.

args.goal: On the buyer's single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes set to None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, and click Done; stop when the create screen is visible again.

steps.note: Configure the two optional, non-mandatory clauses; no catalog domain step can add these clauses.
Add one QA vendor without inventing a vendor company name.
Commit the required 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured RFP.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal in a separate session.
Open the event's technical questionnaire as the vendor.
Accept the first optional clause.
Accept the second optional clause.
Provide the vendor's questionnaire response where the answer field is available.
Submit the vendor's technical response after accepting both clauses.
Assert that the vendor's technical submission was accepted.
Return to the buyer's event view for response verification.
Confirm the buyer sees one vendor response on the technical stage.
